RankingPage.title: How we rank offers
RankingPage.intro: On a product page, shop offers are ordered by fixed, public criteria, the same for every visitor and every shop.

p: Offers are ordered by total price, lowest first: the product price plus the shipping cost given by the shop.
If the shop does not give us a shipping cost, the offer is ranked by its product price and shows “shipping cost not specified”. We never guess shipping costs.
1. Offers in stock come first (then limited stock, pre-order, unknown availability, out of stock).
2. Then the shop with the higher user rating.
3. Then alphabetically by shop name.
Some shops pay us a commission if you buy after visiting them from Pretzuri (marked “Affiliate link”). Commissions do not affect the order of offers.
There are no paid positions today. If we introduce them, they will be shown separately from the ranked list and clearly marked “Promoted”, without changing the order above.
In listings and search you choose the order: relevance, price low to high or high to low, number of offers or newest products. The default order does not depend on any payment.

AffiliatePage.title: About affiliate links
AffiliatePage.intro: Pretzuri does not sell products. We help you compare online shop offers, and some links to shops are affiliate links.

p: When an offer is labelled “Affiliate link”, the link goes through an affiliate network. If you buy, the shop may pay us a commission. Your price is the same.
Commissions do not change the order of offers, the prices shown or which products we show. The order is described on the “How we rank offers” page.
Some shops send us their product list directly. Links to them carry no affiliate parameters and we earn no commission.

sections.h: What we record on a click
p: When you open an offer, we count the click (the offer, the page it came from and whether it looks like a bot). We do not store your IP address or other personal data.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPage.intro: This page describes what data we process when you use Pretzuri.

For visitors without an account: we use no tracking cookies and do not store your IP address on clicks to shops; we only keep the number of clicks per offer.
Accounts, favorites and price alerts will come later; this section will be completed then.
We only use strictly necessary cookies (for example the sign-in session, once available).

You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, and the right to lodge a complaint with the Romanian DPA (ANSPDCP). Contact details will be completed after legal review.

TermsPage.title: Terms and conditions
TermsPage.intro: Terms of use of the Pretzuri price comparison service.

p: [OPERATOR – legal name, company ID, registered address, contact e-mail: to be completed after legal review]
Pretzuri shows offers of online shops, based on data from the shops or affiliate networks. We do not sell products and are not a party to the contract between you and the shop.
Prices, stock and shipping costs can change; the shop's website at the time of ordering is authoritative.
The ranking criteria are published on the “How we rank offers” page.
Rules for shop reviews (writing, moderation, reporting) will be published together with the review feature.
